My academic journey

Every chapter contains smaller milestones. Select a chapter, then select a year to discover the experiences, questions and skills that shaped my path.

2016–2021
Chapter 01 · India

BS–MS in Biological Sciences

IISER Thiruvananthapuram · Major in Biology, minor in Chemistry
2016–2017 · First yearDiscovering biology & earning the KVPY Fellowship

Started my integrated science degree and earned the national KVPY research fellowship with an All India Rank of 13 in 2017. The fellowship gave me the opportunity to pursue research-oriented education.

KVPY AIR 13Interdisciplinary science
May–July 2018 · Second yearNational Institute of Immunology, New Delhi

Explored molecular genetics in Mycobacterium smegmatis through allelic-exchange cloning, restriction digestion, ligation, bacterial transformation and colony screening.

Molecular cloningMicrobiology
May–July 2019 · Third yearACTREC · Cancer Immunotherapy Laboratory

Studied primary human immune-cell function through T-cell and γδ T-cell proliferation, cytotoxicity assays and MDSC–CD4 T-cell co-culture. Investigated zoledronate-associated responses in MCF-7 breast cancer cells using flow cytometry and microscopy.

Cancer immunologyPBMCsFlow cytometry
Jan–Apr 2020 · Fourth yearChemistry minor project · Reji Varghese Lab

Investigated a proposed pH-sensitive drug-delivery strategy for cancer cells. Synthesised and purified nucleoside-based intermediates using multistep organic synthesis and chromatography.

Organic synthesisDrug delivery
Aug 2020–May 2021 · Fifth yearMaster’s thesis · V. Stalin Raj Lab

Developed TaqMan RT-qPCR assays for ferret cytokine responses in influenza vaccine research, working with constructs representing 15 cytokine targets and four housekeeping genes. Systematic optimisation improved amplification for three targets; further validation remained necessary.

Worked with influenza viral RNA in a BSL-2+ laboratory and generated RNA templates through T7 in-vitro transcription.

RNA biologyVaccine immunologyAssay development
2021–2022
Chapter 02 · India

From patient samples to molecular evidence

Scientific Assistant · Cancer Genetics Laboratory, ACTREC

My first full-time research role at Tata Memorial Centre connected molecular genetics with clinically relevant questions. I worked with patient-derived blood samples, genomic DNA extraction, PCR, sequencing and chromatogram analysis.

Aug 2021–Mar 2022Cancer genetics & experimental optimisation

Performed 100–200 PCR reactions daily; investigated RB1, TP53, RET and BRCA; gained hands-on Illumina NGS experience; designed primers and optimised IDH1/DICER amplification through gradient PCR. Used literature to prioritise RB1 exons for targeted sequencing.

Patient samplesSanger sequencingIllumina NGS
2022–2023

Exploring entrepreneurship & business growth

Buildbidz · Digital Marketing & Business Development

My first experience working in a startup introduced me to the commercial side of innovation, from digital communication to understanding competitors and investors.

Aug 2022–Jan 2023Digital Marketing Intern · Buildbidz

Worked on SEO, social media and email marketing, creating advertising videos, blog posts and website content. Contributed to visual identity through logo design and explored customer journeys and website usability.

Digital marketingSEOContent creationBrand identity
Feb–Jul 2023Business Development Intern · Buildbidz

Researched comparable startups and potential investors, compiled findings to support strategic planning and contributed to pitch deck development and preparation for an initial funding round.

Competitor researchInvestor mappingPitch deck supportBusiness development
2023
Chapter 04 · Sweden

Exploring cellular physiology

Jastroch Laboratory · Stockholm University

Investigated human SGBS adipocyte differentiation over 28 days under different insulin, T3 and serum conditions.

Mar–May 2023Cellular differentiation & gene expression

Combined mammalian cell culture, Nile Red fluorescence microscopy, RNA isolation, cDNA synthesis and SYBR RT-qPCR for ADRB1–3. Identified nonspecific ADRB3 amplification through melting-curve analysis. Achieved the highest examination score in Molecular Physiology, Spring 2023.

28-day cultureRT-qPCRCellular metabolism
2023–2025
Chapter 05 · Sweden

Connecting science with innovation

MSc Bioentrepreneurship · Karolinska Institutet
Apr–Jun 2024AbbVie · Market access

Analysed ovarian cancer treatment landscapes across three Nordic markets, developed an Excel patient population calculator and consolidated clinical evidence into a health technology assessment tool.

Oct 2024–Jan 2025Elekta · Corporate research

Investigated unmet needs across six stages of glioblastoma care, using clinical evidence and five stakeholder interviews to explore emerging oncology technologies.

Jan–Jun 2025Master’s thesis · Radiotherapy innovation ecosystems

Conducted 16 semi-structured interviews across Europe and applied reflexive thematic analysis to develop a benchmarking report and strategic roadmap for radiotherapy research and innovation collaboration.
